name: INNIO Jenbacher Type 2/3/4/6/9 and J920 FleXtra
description: lean-burn gas engine generator set / CHP module

specifications.metric: Electrical efficiency, Jenbacher gas engines (general range)
specifications.basis: Jenbacher 'Selecting Power Generation Equipment' page: 'dependable Jenbacher reciprocating gas engines with electrical efficiency usually ranging between 40% and 50%'. Copyright (c) 2026; accessed 2026-11-25.
Wikipedia 'Jenbacher' article, section 'Jenbacher J920 FleXtra': 'a V20 gas engine delivering up to 9.5 MW'. Page last edited 15 June 2026; article is secondary, not OEM datasheet.

Wikipedia 'Jenbacher' article: 'When it is put into production it will be Jenbachers most efficient gas engine available with an electrical efficiency of 48.7%, and a combined heat and power thermal efficiency of over 90%'. Page last edited 15 June 2026.

Clarke Energy 'Jenbacher Gas Engines' page: 'High-efficiency, hydrogen-ready gas engines delivering reliable power from 250 kW to 10.6 MW'; page also states Type 6 1818-4507 kW. Site shows 2025/2026 content dates; accessed 2026-11-25.
Jenbacher product navigation on the page actually read: 'Jenbacher Type 4 Up to 1694 kW/engine'; Type 9 listed 'Up to 10606 kW/engine'. Copyright (c) 2026; accessed 2026-11-25.

notes: Product/catalogue record from a page read in the GEG plant WBS sweep.
